name: Horizon Scout
summary: Off Azshara’s southern coast, Horizon Scout lies sunk in the Ruined Reaches. Captain Vanessa Beltis is stranded ashore, and part of her crew is trapped below the waves.

sections.title: Trapped on the Ocean Floor
sections.body:
Horizon Scout lies wrecked among the Ruined Reaches’ shoals off Azshara’s jagged coast. Captain Vanessa Beltis reached a nearby peninsula, but part of her crew went down with the hull. They still live because Roland Geardabbler, a gnome, sustains a spell of water breathing inside the wreck.

Hostile aquatic predators and predatory naga patrol the waters. The sailors are trapped in the forward compartments and cannot reach the surface alone.

sections.title: The Naga Ambush
sections.body:
A shard of raw Azsharite lies in Horizon Scout’s forward stairwell. The mineral is mysterious and found only on these shores. Spitelash naga prowl the Ruined Reaches and likely struck the ship to seize artifacts or resources from its expedition.

The vessel sank, leaving its survivors unable to escape with any secrets or treasures the coast holds.

faq.q: Where is the Horizon Scout located?
faq.answer: Horizon Scout lies submerged on the ocean floor in the Ruined Reaches, off Azshara’s southern coast.

faq.q: How is the crew still alive underwater?
faq.answer: Roland Geardabbler, a gnome, continually channels water breathing inside the sunken hull, keeping the trapped crew alive in breathable air.
Captain Vanessa Beltis commands Horizon Scout. She reached Azshara’s southern peninsula with a few stranded survivors, while other sailors remain trapped in the hull.

faq.q: What caused the Horizon Scout to sink?
faq.answer: Spitelash naga almost certainly ambushed and sank Horizon Scout. A shard of raw Azsharite on the lower deck suggests they sought mineral riches or artifacts gathered by the expedition.

angles.text: As a gnome, you see the surviving crew depend on Roland Geardabbler’s sustained spell to breathe inside the flooded hull.
As an Alliance member, you find Horizon Scout’s crew divided between shore and sea after a disastrous voyage through Azshara’s perilous waters.
